result:
I added `DELETE /api/v1/items/{id}/description`. It sets the item's description to `None` and returns the updated item. I haven't run the tests or the app, as you asked.

- **Permissions:** it returns 404 if the item doesn't exist. It returns 403 if the caller is neither the owner nor a superuser. This matches the existing item routes.
- **`crud.py`:** I added two functions. `get_item` looks an item up by id. `clear_item_description` clears the description and commits. I added them because the repo rules keep database access out of route handlers.
- **`items.py`:** the new route uses `status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND` and `status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN` instead of integer literals. I left the existing routes unchanged.

I didn't add tests or update the generated frontend client. You can regenerate the client with `bash scripts/generate-client.sh`. There is no `notes/index.md` in this project, so I didn't update any notes.
